cover.hook: 10 ways an AI agent gets turned against you. Save this list.
cover.sub: The OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications, ASI01 to ASI10.

slides.title: ASI01 to ASI03
slides.body:
01 Agent Goal Hijack: hidden instructions redirect the agent.
02 Tool Misuse: connected tools used in ways nobody intended.
03 Identity & Privilege Abuse: overbroad tokens and permissions.

slides.title: ASI04 to ASI06
slides.body:
04 Agentic Supply Chain Vulnerabilities: poisoned tools, plugins, MCP servers.
05 Unexpected Code Execution.
06 Memory & Context Poisoning: bad data that keeps steering the agent later.

slides.title: ASI07 to ASI10
slides.body:
07 Insecure Inter-Agent Communication.
08 Cascading Failures.
09 Human-Agent Trust Exploitation.
10 Rogue Agents.

slides.label: risks in the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications
